info.name: Glamrush API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Glamrush backend service.

## Collection Variables
| Variable | Purpose | Auto-populated |
|----------|---------|----------------|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL | No â€” set to local/staging/prod |
| `authToken` | Sanctum bearer token | Yes â€” on login or register |
| `cartToken` | Guest cart UUID | Yes â€” on first guest add-to-cart |
| `resetCode` | 6-digit password reset code | No â€” copy from email |
| `productSlug` | Slug for GET /products/{slug} | No â€” set a real slug |
| `productId` | Product ULID for cart/saved-item routes | No â€” set a real ULID |

## How to Add New Endpoints
1. Locate the correct folder.
2. Copy an existing request and rename it.
3. Update method, path (in `url.raw`), body fields, and example responses.
4. If the route is auth-protected, set `auth.type = bearer` and use `{{authToken}}`.
5. If it is a guest-supporting cart route, include the `X-Cart-Token` header.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Registration, login, social auth, logout, current user, and password reset flow.

Protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`.
The register and login requests auto-save the returned token to `{{authToken}}`.

Replace `google` in the path with the actual provider (e.g. `facebook`).
The `token` field is the access token obtained from the provider on the client side.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit reset code to the email address. Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration. Copy the code into the `{{resetCode}}` collection variable.

item.name: Storefront
item.description:
Public root-category storefront endpoints. No authentication required.

The homepage is read directly from the shared merchandising tables. Only active, currently scheduled campaigns and sections are exposed. Responses are cached per storefront for the configured homepage cache TTL.

request.description: Returns the fully hydrated public homepage for an active root-category storefront. The campaign can be null and sections can be empty. Supported section types: featured_products, sale_products, category_products, collection_products, newest_products, random_categories, and manual_products.

item.name: Cart
item.description:
Shopping cart. Supports both authenticated users and guests.

**Authenticated**: Include `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`. Response has `cart_token: null`.
**Guest**: Include `X-Cart-Token: {{cartToken}}` header. The token is auto-populated the first time you call Add to Cart without auth.

Cart items expire 1 hour after the last write. Expired items are excluded from GET automatically.

header.description: Guest cart token. Remove this header (or add Authorization instead) for authenticated requests.

response.name: 200 OK â€” Authenticated (no token in response)

header.description: Omit for a new guest cart (a new token is generated and returned). Remove and add Authorization header for authenticated requests.

request.description:
Adds an item to the cart, or increments its quantity if it already exists.
- **201** â€” item did not exist (created).
- **200** â€” item already existed (quantity incremented).
- If sent without `X-Cart-Token` and without auth, a new UUID is generated and returned in `cart_token` â€” save it for subsequent requests.
- The test script auto-saves the returned `cart_token` to `{{cartToken}}`.

response.name: 422 Invalid product_id

request.description: Sets the quantity of an existing cart item. Resets the 1-hour expiry timer.
Removes all items from the cart (for the given user or guest token).

Atomically merges a guest cart into the authenticated user's cart. Shared variants have their quantities summed and stock is validated before any changes are committed. Guest rows are deleted after merging. For storefront-scoped merges, only discard the guest token when guest_cart_empty is true. Cart expiry is refreshed to seven days.

item.name: Saved Items
item.description: User wishlist / saved products. All routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`.

request.description: Saves a product. Returns 201 if newly saved, 200 if already saved (idempotent).
Bulk-adds products to saved items. Only inserts products not already saved â€” existing saved items are left unchanged. Returns the full saved items list after sync. Max 200 product IDs per request.

item.name: Public Content & Contact
item.description: Read-only public content from admin-owned shared tables. Content is not cached. Contact submissions are backend-owned and rate-limited.

request.description: Returns only a currently published global or storefront-assigned page. Draft, scheduled, expired, deleted, and cross-storefront pages return the same 404.
Returns published FAQs grouped by active category with deterministic ordering. per_page is capped at 50.

item.name: Checkout
item.description: Checkout requires Idempotency-Key. Reuse the same key only when retrying an identical request; a different payload with the same key returns 422.

request.description: Previews a discount against the current authenticated or guest cart. Checkout always recalculates the discount authoritatively.

header.description: Keep this value unchanged when retrying this exact checkout payload.

request.description: Creates one order and reserves inventory once. The response includes Idempotent-Replayed: true when an earlier response is replayed.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment initialization is request-idempotent. Verification and webhooks deduplicate provider transactions and finalize payment, order, and inventory atomically.

header.description: Use a new key for a new payment attempt; reuse it for a retry.
